Notes on Thrift
===============

Boost Dependency:
-----------------

Thrift requires the Boost library to be installed so Thrift can be compiled. I was able
to install thrift using the package managers on Mac, CentOS 7 and Ubuntu 22 without too
many problems but I was not able to install it with yum on AmazonLinux2. This was due to some
conflicts with libraries needed for Python that I just couldn't resolve.

Since many boost libraries are header only solutions, one workaround to this was to include
the necessary boost libraries in the repository for the purpose of compiling Thrift. The
Boost library is huge in file size (131MB .tar.gz, over 800MB uncompressed) so I tried to
strip out as much as possible that wasn't being used and got it down to a 12MB compressed
file.


MacOS Dependencies:
-------------------
1. The package manager Homebrew is required to help install the other dependencies.
2. The Thrift autoconfigure script requires Bison >= 2.5. The standard bison included
   with MacOS is 2.3. A newer version can be installed with HomeBrew via the command
   "brew install bison". You *might* need to change the $PATH to use this HomeBrew version
   of bison before the inbuilt MacOS bison. You can do this by adding the following command
   to your ~/.bash_profile file:
   export PATH="$(brew --prefix bison)/bin:$PATH"
3. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. MacOS may provide a version of
   openssl (libreSsl I believe), but it's headers are not found in the usual /usr/local/include
   path. The easiest approach is to install openssl via brew so that the headers are found in
   /usr/local/opt/openssl/include and the library in /usr/local/opt/openssl/lib. The build
   environment will adjust the CPPFLAGS and LD_FLAGS environment variables to also search in
   these locations.


CentOS 7 Dependencies:
----------------------
1. The EPEL7 (Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux) repository must be installed in yum as
   this provides an easier installation for additional packages.
2. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. This can be installed with the command
   "sudo yum install openssl-devel". If successful, there will be headers found at /usr/include/openssl.


Ubuntu 22 Dependencies:
-----------------------
1. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. This can be installed with the command
   "sudo apt-get install libssl-dev". If successful, there will be headers found at /usr/include/openssl.


Configuring Thrift on Mac
-------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on MacOS.

LD_FLAGS='-L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib' CPPFLAGS='-I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include' ./configure \
 --prefix=$(realpath .) \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --with-boost=boost_1_80_0 \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5


Configuring Thrift on CentOS 7 and Ubuntu 22
--------------------------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on CentOS 7 and Ubuntu 22.

./configure \
 --prefix=$(realpath .) \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --with-boost=boost_1_80_0 \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5

* Removed all other files in the root directory.

  - boost/geometry
  - boost/hana
